GameBuilder
Unreal Engine 5.8 C++ project MIT v0.6.0 beta

Editor plugin for Unreal Engine 5.8

An empty project goes in. By the ninth tab, a game comes out.

GameBuilder is a production pipeline that lives inside the Unreal editor. Nine workshop tabs, arranged in the order games are actually made, each writing real engine assets and handing them to the next. Walk them left to right and you finish with combat, loot, quests, rewards, a HUD and saving — with no Blueprint wiring in between.

The nine tabs

Every tab produces something the next one uses.

Screens below are from a real run on an empty C++ project with only this plugin installed — the same project the acceptance suite tests. The interface ships in Korean today; English localization is on the roadmap.

01

Landscape

Pick a preset and a size, generate the heightmap, apply it to the level. Layer materials are bound at the same time, and the textures they need are downloaded from ambientCG (CC0) into your project on first use.

land.preset · land.size · land.generate · land.apply
02

Material

The layer catalog with per-channel status. Color and normal are required; ambient occlusion, roughness and displacement are taken when the source asset has them.

catalog of 15 CC0 sets
03

Character

Create a character, fill its slots, build it. On an empty project the engine template mannequin is provisioned automatically, motions are bound, a Blueprint is generated and Gameplay Ability System attributes are wired — the first build of a fresh project does all of that in one step.

char.new · char.slot · char.build
04

Prop

Assemble a prop from part slots, set its real-world size in centimetres, build it into a Blueprint with procedural mesh components.

prop.new · prop.slot · prop.unit · prop.build
05

Item

Items carry stats and effects the runtime actually applies. Equipping raises attack by exactly what the item declares — the runtime smoke asserts the number, not just that it went up.

item.new · item.stat · item.effect
06

Effect

Niagara presets with five parameters each. Seeding writes the actual system asset into your project; the preview never loads an asset that has not been created yet.

fx.param · fx.seed
07

Level placement

Plan zones, add the props you built, place them into the world. Zones carry size, anchor, biome and a World Partition data layer.

level.new · level.add · level.place
08

Quest

Objectives, rewards and prerequisite chains. The seed chain — talk, travel, hunt — is completable on a fresh project, and its reward item exists because the pipeline guarantees it.

quest.new · quest.obj · quest.reward · quest.auto
09

UI

Author a screen as a constrained HTML draft and convert it into a UMG Widget Blueprint. Anchors stay resolution-independent, and the runtime falls back to a C++ HUD when no widget asset is present.

ui.html · ui.make

Verification

The install is tested the way a stranger would do it.

An empty UE 5.8 C++ project is reset to its initial state, the distributed package is copied in, and the suite drives the editor through all nine tabs and then runs the game. Raw logs and result JSON are published in the repository.

StageResultWhat it proves
Editor session, nine tabs36 / 36Every free verb answers with the exact result contract, effect preview never loads a missing asset, mannequin provisioning never fails.
Defect-fix paths16 / 16Each previously fixed defect is re-driven through its failure path and must still fail loudly, including negative quest rewards clamped on disk.
Runtime: combat, loot, equipok = trueReal kill, real drop, pickup, material refused for equipping, equipment raises attack by its declared value (10 → 15).
Runtime: quest integrationok = truePrerequisite chain, five kills, three collected drops, turn-in, reward granted and equipped, save and reload, corrupt save recovered.
Runtime: UI and cutsceneok = trueTen widgets, resolution-independent anchors, optional sequence assets absent without breaking the level.
Runtime: quest chain4 / 4Every seed quest completes and pays out.
Fatal errors, assertions0Across every stage of the run.

Where it stands

What is finished, and what is not.

Beta

v0.6.0

Usable end to end and covered by the suite above. Interfaces can still change before v1.0.

Planned

Groups beyond the nine

The hub shows further groups — 2D assets, animation, storyboard, movie maker, sound. They open a roadmap page and their chips say so. Only the nine tabs ship today.

Optional

AI backends

Generation runs through local AI CLIs with your own credentials, and anything that costs credits asks first. Every verb on this page works with no backend connected at all.

Language

Korean interface

The editor UI and result messages are Korean today. English localization is planned for the first funded quarter.
